title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Swamp Battleguard Metal Raiders MRD-063 Regular Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Embrace the nostalgia with the 1996 Yu-Gi-Oh! Swamp Battleguard MRD-063, a staple from the classic Metal Raiders set. As a common card with the unlimited feature, it's a must-have for both new enthusiasts and seasoned collectors looking to complete their deck with a touch of vintage flair. The card showcases the Earth attribute and the formidable Warrior creature type, ready to enhance your gameplay.

Crafted by Konami, this English-language card is designed for players aged 4 and up. It's a standard-sized monster card made from durable card stock, featuring the regular finish that players and collectors have come to recognize. Proudly manufactured in the United States, the Swamp Battleguard stands as a testament to the enduring legacy of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG.
